say: You speak at a hundred and fifty words a minute. You type at forty.
Whisper Flow gets that. But its free plan runs out, and its code is closed.
Hold a key. Speak. Release. Your words land in any app, in under a second.
It runs fully offline. Your voice never leaves your computer.
No account. No limits. No subscription.
And it's open source. Want a feature? Add it.
